summary: Equinor ASA filed a Form 6-K on August 19, 2026, reporting a routine buy-back of shares under its employee share incentive programme. The programme was announced on February 4, 2026, runs from February 13, 2026 to January 15, 2027, with a total purchase amount of NOK 1,971,000,000 and a maximum of 19,600,000 shares. On August 14, 2026, Equinor repurchased 415,000 shares at an average price of NOK 382.7682 per share. Following these transactions, Equinor holds 16,809,915 own shares, representing 0.70% of its share capital. This is a routine capital return transaction under an existing buy-back programme, not a special situation, with no strategic or structural implications.
